name: streak
title: Streak
description: How many in a row, drawn as a flame beside the number. A thin wrapper over stat: the number, the label, the change beside it and the announcement are stat's, and streak adds only the flame. A broken streak is `value={0}`, a real state that reads as "streak, 0", rather than an attribute of its own. A live flame is solid and a broken one is hollow with a wisp curling off it, so outline, fill and stroke count all differ and the break survives colour blindness, a muted tab and reduced motion. Carries no max, because a streak has no ceiling. Performs nothing: it does not count or decide when a streak breaks. Draws as a pill, which is what the design draws.
docs: Pass `value` as the count in a row and `delta={1}` on the render after it grows. Zero is how a break is expressed, so set `value={0}` rather than looking for a broken flag. Pass `critical` when the host decides the run is about to go; stat renders its own glyph inside the group and the flame on the root is untouched. The flame is `aria-hidden`, because stat already announces "streak, 7" and announcing it again would read the number twice.
